method: Assistant visual inspection of decoded contact sheets, not manual viewing of all 9000 frames.
observations: Core recovery, first failed launch, cart braking and ring capture retain visible spatial continuity.
Release and catch show the core travelling between amber and cyan; the rope remains linked to the black character.
The controlled launch reaches the same receiver; its power state persists into the bridge sequence.
The brake callback precedes the bridge sag; amber and the black character share a hand target while cyan returns the cart.
Chapter boundary pairs preserve positions without a scene reset; visible text is English.
limits: The figures overlap briefly around the cart and during the final hand-stop gag; the three colors distinguish them, but these are tight compositions.
Review sampled temporal sequences and boundary frames. It does not certify every frame or subjective humor.
Audio review was technical; no human listening evaluation.
